citations.context: But this is from the Bible, but it's just a fable. It's a story. The Bible is a fable, okay? And I just want to take this fable, this story. Look at it. Now, it says this. I love this story. Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate, and they said to one another, why do we sit here until we die? If we say we will enter the city, then the famine is in the city, and we're gonna die there. And if we sit here, we're gonna die also.
